description: Adapt Stack Overflow Express.js rate limiter to Fastify. Read CONVENTIONS.md for team standards (camelCase, 'handle' prefix for error handlers, credit sources in JSDoc, async/await). The Express example is in src/utils/rate_limiter_example.js. Create Fastify-compatible rate limiter in src/middleware/rate_limiter.js that: (1) imports config from config/rate_limit.config.js, (2) uses config values (windowMs, maxRequestsPerWindow, errorMessage) not hardcoded numbers, (3) uses Fastify patterns (request/reply not req/res, plugin/hook pattern), (4) follows camelCase convention, (5) names error handler like handleRateLimitError, (6) includes JSDoc comment with Stack Overflow attribution. Update src/server.js to import and register the rate limiter (apply to /api/data and /api/users but NOT /api/status). Delete or move src/utils/rate_limiter_example.js to docs/references/ after adapting.
